You will be working as part of a team to support the People Governance Team Lead to provide a visible and highly proactive People governance service to management and all employees across the FNZ.
  
  
You will be required to work closely with key stakeholders across the business including internal and external audit, risk, compliance, information security and legal teams, to ensure there is effective People governance, controls and compliance with current legislative, regulatory and industry standards and regulations.
  
  
This role will manage various People Risk and Compliance projects on a day to day basis. There will also be responsibility for assisting the People team in administering and maintaining BAU tasks as required. This role will add value meet the People strategic business goals supporting the risk and compliance culture and embedding the FNZ values to create strong foundation.
  
  
This role will drive multiple critical People projects within an established organisation.
  
  
**Specific Role Responsibilities**

* Be the key contact for People Risk Management, providing support to the People team managers and Head of Functions to embed risk management processes, use appropriate framework tools (FNZ’s Risk & Control (FRanC) system) to ensure a consistent approach globally.
* Provide support, guidance & assistance to the People team in respect of People governance , including general queries, regulatory obligations, industry standards, current legislation , and support in logging risk events and information in the relevant systems.

* Will co-ordinate 1st line Governance meetings and outputs regionally, and reporting out to relevant Risk & Compliance Committees. Ensuring regional outputs for regional 1st Line Governance meetings are captured and escalated to Group where necessary.

* Ensure that all local People policies are reviewed, updated, and comply with both internal and external guidelines/laws in a timely manner. Create new documentation where a gap is identified.

Our ambition is to create a culture for growth, one that opens up limitless opportunities for our employees, customers and the wider world. The FNZ Way is the cornerstone of what we do. It is comprised of four values that set the standard for how everyone at FNZ interacts with each other, with our customers, and with all our diverse stakeholders around the world.
  
  

* Customer obsessed for the long-term
* Think big and make an impact
* Act now and own it all the way

: www.fnz.com/culture
  
  
**About FNZ**

description:

title: Talent Insights Manager - Global Businesses & Functions
description:
**Locations**
: Gurgaon | London
  
  
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
As a Talent Insights Manager, you will help our Global Businesses & Functions (GBF) build a more integrated and forward-looking understanding of our existing workforce and talent and translate that intelligence into better talent and workforce decisions. You will bring together internal data on workforce composition, roles, competencies, hiring, compensation, performance, potential, career progression, and retention with external intelligence on labor-market dynamics, emerging skills, talent scarcity, and market compensation.
  
  
Your focus will be on connecting these signals, not simply reporting them, to identify emerging talent and capability risks and translate them into strategic guidance. You will help leaders understand where critical talent sits today, where internal or external trends may create future risks, and where BCG may need to adjust how we attract, recognize, reward, and retain the talent and capabilities most important to our future.
  
  
You will also help advance our analytics maturity over time, moving from primarily historical reporting toward stronger leading indicators, scenario analysis, and increasingly forward-looking workforce insights and decision support.
  
  
**Key Activities**

* Support the continued development of BCG’s workforce reporting and analytics, improving the consistency, quality, and usefulness of existing HR metrics while identifying opportunities to simplify and automate recurring analysis.
* Analyze workforce data including headcount, roles, competencies, hiring, performance, potential, promotions, and attrition to identify trends and areas requiring further investigation.
* Compare talent data across employee populations to identify patterns in hiring, performance, progression, retention, and other workforce outcomes.
* Combine compensation data with performance, potential, career progression, talent scarcity, and available market benchmarks to help assess how effectively BCG is recognizing and retaining key talent and identify where compensation actions may warrant consideration.
* Incorporate external labor-market data to provide context on talent availability, emerging skills, hiring demand, compensation, and areas where critical talent may be harder to attract or retain.
* Build on historical reporting by testing new metrics and leading indicators that can provide earlier visibility into emerging workforce trends and risks and develop scenario analyses that help leaders understand the potential implications of different workforce and talent choices.
* Leverage AI and emerging analytical tools to accelerate analysis, identify patterns and anomalies, test hypotheses, and explore new ways to make workforce insights more scalable and actionable.
* Prepare analyses, dashboards, decision-support tools, and leadership materials that clearly explain findings, supporting data, and areas that may warrant action or further analysis.
* Maintain accuracy and consistency across complex datasets while connecting detailed findings to broader business questions and applying appropriate judgment to the interpretation and use of data and AI-generated insights.

What You'll Bring
  
  

* 6–8 years of experience in analytics, HR, workforce planning, talent, consulting, or related roles, with experience using data to inform business decisions.
* Bachelor’s degree with experience working with complex workforce, talent, or business data.
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to connect detailed data and metrics to broader workforce and business questions and develop and test hypotheses.
* Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office and Power BI, plus demonstrated ability to use GenAI and other analytical tools to support analysis and problem solving.
* Experience combining and interpreting data from multiple sources to identify trends, relationships, and anomalies, and areas requiring further investigation.
* Experience translating complex analyses into clear, structured materials and insights for senior leadership, including implications and potential areas for action.
* Strong attention to detail and organization, with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining accuracy and data integrity.

The following experience would be beneficial but is not required:
  
  

* Experience with workforce planning, compensation, talent analytics, or external labor-market intelligence.
* Experience with scenario analysis, forecasting, or other forward-looking analytical approaches.
* Experience using AI, automation, or other technology to simplify or scale recurring analytical work.

Who You'll Work With
  
  
You will be part of our Global Businesses & Function HR team, sitting within the Talent Insights & Compensation team. This team brings together workforce, talent, compensation, and external market information to help our businesses and functions better understand their talent and inform people decisions.
  
  
You will work across BCG’s global corporate functions and businesses, partnering with HR and business leaders and teams to understand their workforce questions and translate available data into meaningful insights. You will also collaborate with colleagues across talent, compensation, recruiting, and other HR teams to connect different perspectives and provide a more complete view of our workforce and talent.
  
  
Additional info
  
  
At BCG, our people and relationships are at the heart of everything we do. We believe that in-person collaboration plays an important role in our culture, mentorship, and professional development.
  
  
For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.
  
  
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.
  
  
BCG is an E - Verify Employer. Click here for more information on E-Verify.

title: Human Resources Associate
description:
Talent Acquisition & HR Operations AssociateDarwix AI | Full-Time | On-Site | 0–2 Years Experience

**Location:**
Imperia Mindspace, Sector 62, Gurugram, Haryana

**Working hours:**
10:45 AM – 8:00 PM

**Working days:**
Monday to Friday + Alternate Saturdays

**Experience:**
0–2 years (exceptional freshers encouraged to apply)

**Department:**
Human Resources & Talent Acquisition

**Reporting to:**
Founders / Leadership Team

**Employment Type:**
Full-time, Work from Office

About Darwix AI

Darwix AI is a growing enterprise AI company building physical-first Agentic AI solutions for complex business workflows, particularly in BFSI.

Our technology combines Voice AI Agents, Sherpa AI, Real-Time Agent Assist, Document Intelligence, QA and Compliance Intelligence, and an agentic orchestration layer to help enterprises translate real-world conversations into structured intelligence and governed actions.

With 50+ enterprise relationships across six geographies, we are building a team capable of solving meaningful AI and business challenges at scale.

We are looking for a highly energetic, resourceful, technology-oriented HR professional who wants to help build that team.

The Opportunity

This is not a conventional HR coordination position.

We are looking for someone who enjoys finding exceptional people, engaging with prospective candidates, understanding their capabilities, convincing them to explore opportunities, and driving hiring processes to closure.

You will be responsible for building recruitment pipelines for technical, product, AI, sales, business and operations positions while simultaneously supporting end-to-end HR operations.

You should be comfortable using LinkedIn, professional databases, hiring platforms, AI tools, campus networks and unconventional sourcing techniques.

You will work closely with the founders and hiring managers, gaining exposure to how a rapidly growing enterprise AI business hires and operates.

Key Responsibilities1. End-to-End Recruitment Ownership

* Understand hiring requirements directly from founders and functional heads.
* Translate requirements into clear JDs, ideal candidate profiles and screening criteria.
* Independently source, shortlist, engage and evaluate suitable candidates.
* Conduct initial HR screening and qualification calls.
* Evaluate experience, communication, motivation, compensation expectations, availability and role alignment.
* Coordinate technical, functional and leadership interviews.
* Maintain candidate engagement throughout the selection process.
* Own follow-ups, offer discussions, negotiation and joining coordination.
* Build backup pipelines for critical positions.
* Track recruitment progress against agreed hiring priorities.

2. AI, Engineering and Product Hiring

A significant part of this role involves recruiting for technology and product positions.

You should develop a functional understanding of profiles such as:

* AI/ML Engineers
* Generative AI and LLM Engineers
* Python / Backend Engineers
* Full-Stack Developers
* AI Product Managers
* Product Analysts
* Data Scientists and Analysts
* AI Implementation and Solutions Engineers
* Technical interns and graduate trainees

You are not expected to be a software engineer. However, you should be willing to learn enough about technical terminology and candidate backgrounds to distinguish credible profiles from keyword-heavy resumes.

Develop familiarity with Python, APIs, LLMs, RAG, model evaluation, AI workflows and software development fundamentals.

Work with technical hiring managers to understand essential skills, project depth and interview evaluation criteria.

3. Sales, Growth and Business Hiring

Support recruitment for:

* Enterprise Sales
* B2B and SaaS Sales
* Business Development
* SDR / BDR
* Customer Success
* Account Management
* Implementation and Client Delivery
* Growth and Marketing
* Business Operations

Assess candidates for commercial awareness, communication, enterprise selling exposure, target ownership, stakeholder management and ability to operate in a startup environment.

4. LinkedIn and Multi-Channel Sourcing

Develop consistent, high-quality sourcing capabilities across:

* LinkedIn and LinkedIn Recruiter
* Naukri, Instahyre, Indeed, Wellfound and Cutshort
* GitHub and relevant technical communities
* College placement networks and alumni groups
* Employee referrals
* Professional communities
* Existing resume databases
* Targeted outreach and candidate referrals

Key activities include:

* Boolean and X-ray search.
* Competitor and target-company talent mapping.
* Identifying passive candidates.
* Creating personalized recruitment messages.
* Building reusable candidate pipelines.
* Re-engaging suitable candidates from previous hiring processes.
* Measuring sourcing-channel effectiveness.

We are especially interested in candidates who enjoy finding talent rather than simply waiting for job applications.

5. AI-Enabled Recruitment

You should be enthusiastic about applying modern AI tools to recruitment and HR workflows.

Examples include:

* Using ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or similar tools to help create JDs.
* Generating structured screening questions.
* Extracting job-relevant information from resumes using approved tools.
* Creating consistent candidate evaluation summaries.
* Personalizing sourcing messages.
* Preparing interview scorecards.
* Consolidating interview feedback.
* Identifying recruitment pipeline bottlenecks.
* Building hiring reports and dashboards.
* Automating repetitive administrative activities.

You must verify AI-generated outputs, protect candidate information and ensure recruitment decisions receive appropriate human review.

6. Campus Recruitment and University Partnerships

Build relationships with placement cells and talent teams across universities and colleges.

Responsibilities include:

* Identifying campuses relevant to AI, engineering, product and business hiring.
* Coordinating internships and graduate hiring opportunities.
* Managing communication with placement officers.
* Organizing assessments, hiring drives and interviews.
* Maintaining a database of college relationships.
* Creating structured internship-to-employment pipelines.
* Managing joining and documentation for campus hires.

7. Salary Negotiation and Offer Closure

Own candidate conversations across the offer stage, including:

* Understanding current compensation and candidate expectations.
* Evaluating fixed versus variable compensation structures.
* Working within approved salary budgets.
* Managing competing-offer situations.
* Communicating compensation and employment terms accurately.
* Negotiating professionally without making unauthorized commitments.
* Issuing and coordinating offer documentation.
* Managing offer acceptance and notice-period engagement.
* Minimizing offer-to-joining drop-offs.

We value candidates who can balance employee expectations, business economics and relationship management.

8. HR Operations and Employee Lifecycle

Support smooth day-to-day HR operations, including:

**Pre-joining and onboarding**

* Documentation and joining formalities.
* Employee database creation.
* Offer and employment records.
* Induction and onboarding coordination.
* IT, administration and reporting-manager coordination.

**Employee operations**

* Attendance and leave administration.
* Payroll-input coordination with finance.
* Maintaining accurate employee records.
* HR policies and internal communication.
* Employee query resolution.
* Probation review coordination.
* Employee engagement activities.
* Tracking important employee lifecycle milestones.

**Exit management**

* Exit formalities.
* Asset and document handovers.
* Clearance coordination.
* Employee record updates.
* Exit feedback administration.

Maintain confidentiality and professional handling of employee information.

9. Recruitment Analytics and Founder Reporting

Maintain accurate, frequently updated hiring trackers.

You should be comfortable reporting on:

* Open positions and priority vacancies.
* Candidates sourced and contacted.
* Response and screening conversion rates.
* Shortlists submitted.
* Interview progress.
* Interview-to-offer conversion.
* Offer acceptance and joining rates.
* Recruitment turnaround time.
* Sourcing-channel productivity.
* Campus hiring progress.

Required Skills and Competencies

* Strong verbal and written English communication.
* Confidence in professional outreach and candidate conversations.
* Interest in technology, AI and enterprise business.
* Strong working knowledge of LinkedIn.
* Ability to conduct structured research.
* Attention to detail and disciplined follow-up.
* Basic spreadsheet and data-management capabilities.
* Ability to coordinate multiple vacancies simultaneously.
* Professional judgment and confidentiality.
* Comfortable using modern productivity and AI tools.
* Ability to independently execute tasks and take ownership.
* Strong willingness to learn and adapt.

Preferred Qualifications

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in HR, Business Administration, Management, Commerce, Psychology or a related discipline.
* 0–2 years of experience in recruitment, HR operations, talent acquisition, internships or campus placement activities.
* Prior exposure to startup recruitment, IT hiring, SaaS hiring or technical talent sourcing is advantageous.
* Experience conducting LinkedIn sourcing or initial candidate screening is desirable.
* Freshers with demonstrable recruitment projects, internships or strong sourcing capabilities are welcome.

Who Will Succeed in This Role?

Someone who:

* Enjoys speaking to new people and building professional relationships.
* Is persistent without being unnecessarily aggressive.
* Can move comfortably between AI engineering and sales hiring requirements.
* Enjoys discovering and experimenting with new technology.
* Takes ownership instead of waiting for repeated instructions.
* Understands that hiring success requires both quality and speed.
* Is organized enough to manage several parallel hiring journeys.
* Is comfortable working closely with founders.
* Wants to build a meaningful long-term career in talent acquisition and HR.

Working Arrangements

This is a full-time, work-from-office position.

**Office:**
Imperia Mindspace, Sector 62, Gurugram, Haryana.

**Office hours:**
10:45 AM to 8:00 PM.

**Working schedule:**
Monday to Friday, with alternate Saturdays working.

title: Finance & HR Manager
company: Acumen, Part of Sannam S4 Group
description:
**We're Hiring for Intralink – A Global Business Development Consultancy** 




  





 We are excited to be recruiting on behalf of Intralink, an international business development and innovation consultancy that specializes in helping companies expand into global markets. With over 36 years of experience and a presence in more than 28 locations across Asia, Europe, and North America, Intralink partners with startups, scaleups, multinationals, and government agencies to drive international growth, innovation, and sustainability.
 



  





 Intralink has been recognized with prestigious awards, including the UK's King's Award for Enterprise and the US President's E Award, for its exceptional work in facilitating international business expansion.
 



  





**Finance \& HR Manager, Intralink India** 




**Background** 




 Are you someone who enjoys bringing structure, clarity and financial discipline to a fast\-moving, international work environment?
 



  





 Do you thrive at the intersection of finance and people operations?
 



  





 And, do you want to play a pivotal role in supporting a globally connected consulting firm as it grows its footprint in India?
 



  





 If that’s yes, yes and yes, you may be who we are looking for to join our team.
 



  





 Intralink is a global business development consultancy specialising in international markets. With over 25 offices worldwide and more than 200 multilingual professionals, we support companies across technology, industrial, consumer and sustainability\-driven sectors to expand internationally.
 



  





 As we continue to grow our India presence, we are looking for a Finance \& HR Manager to take ownership of the India office’s financial operations, HR administration and broader office management. You’ll report directly to the India Managing Director and work closely with our UK headquarters, playing a trusted role in ensuring smooth, compliant and efficient operations on the ground.
 



  





**What you’ll be doing** 




 You’ll be responsible for managing the financial health and HR operations of Intralink’s India office.
 



 Acting as a key point of contact between local operations and UK headquarters, you’ll ensure robust financial controls, accurate reporting, and seamless coordination with external partners.
 



  





**Accounting \& Finance** 




 In your day\-to\-day, you’ll manage daily bank operations, oversee staff expense claims and reimbursements, and monitor expenditure against approved budgets. You’ll prepare and report monthly management accounts to headquarters, support annual budgeting and quarterly forecasting, and provide sound financial advice to the India Managing Director.
 



  





 You’ll coordinate closely with vendors, external accountants and auditors on GST, manage corporate income tax filings and statutory audits, assist in implementing standard accounting policies, and ensure all financial records are properly maintained. You’ll also manage locally issued client invoices, credit control processes, and staff severance and pension arrangements where applicable.
 



  





**HR \& Payroll Support** 




 You’ll support core HR operations including payroll processing, withholding tax filings and year\-end tax settlements. This will include assisting with staff onboarding and offboarding, benefits enrolment, annual health insurance renewals and responding to employee queries related to salaries and administrative matters.
 



  





 You’ll maintain accurate personnel and leave records, support recruitment\-related logistics such as interviews or job fairs when required, provide documentation for staff visas, and organise mandatory annual training or health check\-ups. Ensuring HR compliance and supporting ad\-hoc people\-related initiatives will also form part of your role.
 



  





 You’ll also stay aware of changes to Indian labour laws to ensure ongoing compliance and help organise board meetings on a quarterly basis.
 



  





**What you’ll be getting** 




 ● Competitive and negotiable salary, depending on experience
 



 ● 20 days of paid annual leave per year
 



 ● Health insurance coverage
 



 ● A multinational working environment with close collaboration across global offices
 



 ● Exposure to international business operations and senior stakeholders
 



 ● A trusted, high\-impact role supporting leadership and business growth in India
 



  





**What you’ll need** 




 • 5\+ years of relevant work experience in accounting or finance, strongly preferred
 



 • Hands\-on experience with accounting systems (NetSuite experience highly desirable)
 



 • Strong knowledge of accounting principles, financial controls and administrative procedures
 



 • Solid understanding of office management systems and HR administration
 



 • Excellent organisational, planning and multitasking skills, with strong attention to detail
 



 • Ability to prioritise effectively and work independently in a fast\-paced environment
 



 • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint)
 



 • Advanced spoken and written English skills
 



 • Native or fluent Hindi
 



  





 This position is based in India and will require regular interaction with Intralink’s UK headquarters and local stakeholders.
 



 Please submit a CV and Cover Letter detailing your experience and motivations for applying to this role.

You will work directly on company research, lead generation, corporate outreach, hiring coordination, candidate mapping and relationship management.

* Research companies hiring across EV, automotive, manufacturing, engineering, software, electronics, battery, mobility and related sectors.

* Build and maintain a structured corporate database.

* Schedule meetings with relevant corporate stakeholders.
* Conduct timely and professional follow\-ups with prospects.

* Support interviews, assessments and hiring drives.

* Follow up with candidates and companies until the hiring process is completed.
* Support OJT, internship, placement drives and Recruitathons.



  





**4\. Employer \& Industry Relationship Support** 



* Maintain professional relationships with HRs and recruiters.
* Capture and communicate company feedback to the internal team.
* Track repeat hiring opportunities from existing corporate relationships.
* Identify opportunities for long\-term corporate partnerships and MoUs.
* Support the Corporate Relations team in building a strong employer network.



  





**5\. College \& Placement Cell Outreach** 



* Research colleges, universities, ITIs, diploma institutions and engineering institutes.
* Identify TPOs, placement officers, HODs and relevant institutional contacts.
* Support outreach for placement collaborations, hiring drives, Recruitathons and industry programs.
* Build and maintain college databases and communication records.



  





**6\. MIS, CRM \& Documentation** 



* Maintain corporate, candidate and college databases.
* Update lead status, follow\-up dates, requirements and outcomes.
* Prepare daily and weekly MIS reports.
* Track pending follow\-ups and ensure leads are not missed.
* Maintain accurate records of corporate requirements, candidate mapping and hiring activities.

* Graduate in HR, Marketing, Management, Engineering or a related discipline.
* MBA/PGDM is preferred.
* Freshers and candidates seeking internship experience are encouraged to apply.
* **Strong interest in Corporate Relations, HR, Recruitment or the EV industry.**



  





**Must\-Have Skills** 



* Excellent verbal and written communication
* Confidence in speaking with HRs and professionals
* Strong follow\-up and relationship\-building ability
* Research and lead\-generation skills
* Good LinkedIn usage and professional networking ability
* Professional email and WhatsApp communication
* Basic Excel/Google Sheets knowledge
* Strong organization and time\-management skills

* Prior internship in HR, Sales or Corporate Relations
* Experience with CRM or lead\-management tools
* Understanding of recruitment and placement processes
* Knowledge of the EV, automotive or mobility industry
* Basic understanding of LinkedIn prospecting

 The ideal candidate is proactive, confident, curious and comfortable communicating with new people. You should be willing to pick up the phone, conduct research, send professional messages, follow up consistently and take ownership of assigned leads.
 





 You should be comfortable working in a fast\-paced environment where priorities can change and results depend on consistent execution. Most importantly, we are looking for someone with a learning mindset, professional attitude, accountability and genuine interest in building an industry network.
 




  





**Key Performance Expectations** 



* Build and continuously update a high\-quality corporate prospect database.
* Generate and qualify relevant corporate leads on a regular basis.
* Maintain consistent follow\-ups and accurate lead\-status tracking.
* Support timely candidate mapping and hiring coordination against company JDs.
* Maintain professional communication with corporate and institutional stakeholders.

title: SENIOR MANAGER – HUMAN RESOURCES  & PEOPLE OPERATIONS
description:
**Delhi NCR \| Full\-Time \| On\-Site \| 4–6 Years Experience**




 We are looking for a sharp, ambitious and highly dependable 
 **Senior Manager – Human Resources \& People Operations** 
  to establish and run the core HR operating systems of our Delhi NCR headquarters.
 



 This is a broad, hands\-on management mandate covering 
 **recruitment, payroll management, employee lifecycle, HR systems, international personnel administration, work\-authorisation coordination, performance processes, HR compliance, employee records and management reporting** 
 .
 



 The person joining us will not simply inherit an existing HR desk. They will help build a disciplined and scalable People Operations function capable of supporting a growing Indian and international workforce.
   





 The Senior Manager – Human Resources \& People Operations will be responsible for establishing and operating the 
 **Delhi HQ HR infrastructure** 
  and ensuring that employee administration is accurate, controlled, responsive and scalable.
 



 The role will include:
 


1. Establishing the core 
 **HR operating framework for the Delhi NCR headquarters** 
 , including HRIS, employee master data, personnel files, joining systems, attendance, leave, payroll controls, probation, performance\-cycle administration and separation processes.
2. Managing 
 **end\-to\-end payroll administration and payroll coordination** 
 , including monthly employee data, attendance and leave inputs, salary changes, approved deductions, reimbursements, variable\-pay inputs, new joiners, exits and payroll reconciliation.
3. Working with Finance, payroll vendors and management to ensure that payroll records reconcile with approved employment terms and employee master data.
4. Maintaining payroll calendars, change\-control records, salary/CTC documentation and payroll exception trackers.
5. Coordinating statutory and employee\-related payroll documentation with the appropriate Finance, Legal, payroll and professional advisers.
6. Managing end\-to\-end recruitment across multiple concurrent managerial, specialist, technical and administrative mandates.
7. Managing RPOs, recruitment agencies, LinkedIn, job portals, direct sourcing and referral channels.
8. Coordinating candidate assessment, interview scheduling, approvals, compensation discussions, offers and joining.
9. Managing BGV, references, pre\-employment documentation and controlled onboarding.
10. Creating and maintaining accurate employee records, organisation data, reporting relationships, designation/grade records and employment\-history documentation.
11. Managing attendance, leave, probation, confirmation, promotions, approved compensation changes, transfers and employee status changes.
12. Operationalising Board\- and management\-approved HR, workplace, travel, employee and administrative policies.
13. Maintaining policy acknowledgements, training evidence, compliance registers and HR audit documentation.
14. Supporting performance\-management administration, including 
 **30/60/90\-day reviews, probation reviews, confirmation documentation, performance records and management follow\-up** 
 .
15. Handling employee grievances, disciplinary documentation, difficult employee matters, resignations, handovers, separation processes and final\-clearance coordination.
16. Maintaining appropriate confidentiality and access controls for sensitive personnel and compensation data.
17. Coordinate 
 **international employee mobility** 
 , including visa/work\-authorisation, immigration, FRRO/FRO and renewal documentation through Legal/authorised advisers.
18. Maintain complete 
 **passport, visa, permit, registration and expiry controls** 
  for foreign personnel and international specialists.
19. Coordinate 
 **invitation letters, supporting documentation, relocation, accommodation and joining logistics** 
  for international employees.
20. Maintain an 
 **International Personnel \& Mobility Register** 
  covering status, expiries, pending actions and responsible owners.
21. Ensure required documentation and internal clearances are complete before international personnel commence regulated or approval\-dependent activities.
22. Support overseas deputation, travel and assignment documentation for Indian employees where required.
23. Establish and maintain the 
 **Delhi HQ HR operating system** 
 , including Employee Master, HRIS, recruitment pipeline, offers, BGV, joining, personnel files, attendance/leave and payroll controls.
24. Maintain 
 **compensation\-change, probation, confirmation, performance\-review, policy\-acknowledgement and training records** 
 .
25. Maintain 
 **grievance, disciplinary, separation, clearance, HR\-vendor and management\-MIS systems** 
 .
26. Own the 
 **HR\-side payroll process and reconciliation controls** 
  in coordination with Finance and authorised service providers.



  




 WHAT WE EXPECT IN THE FIRST 90 DAYS
 
 Within the first three months, the successful candidate should be able to demonstrate:
 


* a functioning Delhi HQ HR operating system;
* complete employee master and controlled personnel files;
* recruitment dashboard covering all approved vacancies;
* functioning HRIS or controlled interim HR database;
* reliable attendance and leave administration;
* documented monthly payroll process and reconciliation controls;
* BGV and onboarding tracker;
* probation and confirmation calendar;
* approved policy implementation and acknowledgement records;
* management HR dashboard;
* international personnel / visa / work\-authorisation tracker where applicable;
* HR vendor and recruiter controls;
* defined employee joining, lifecycle and separation workflows.


 THE PERSON WE WANT
 
 We are looking for somebody who can 
 **build systems and then operate them** 
 .
 



 A strong candidate will be equally comfortable interviewing a senior candidate in the morning, resolving a payroll discrepancy before lunch, checking the documentation of an international employee in the afternoon and preparing a concise management dashboard before the day ends.
 



 That breadth is intentional.
 



 The role suits an HR professional who wants genuine ownership and institutional\-building responsibility — not somebody looking for a narrowly defined recruitment, HRBP or employee\-engagement position.
 


 Particularly valuable experience
 
 Candidates who have previously helped establish a 
 **new corporate office, regional headquarters, business unit, plant, international office or rapidly expanding operation** 
  will be particularly relevant.
 



 Exposure to any combination of the following will be valuable:
 



***HRIS implementation • Payroll management • Multi\-agency recruitment • International employees • Employment visas / mobility administration • BGV • Employee lifecycle • HR compliance • Performance administration • Office mobilisation • Regulated or industrial environments***




 This addition makes the position substantially stronger. It now reads as the 
 **person responsible for establishing the Delhi HQ People Operations infrastructure** 
 , rather than simply a Senior HR recruitment manager.

title: Senior Manager, HR and Business Operations
description:
**Role: Senior Manager, HR and Business Operations** 




  





**Company:** 
 STEPS Talent Consulting Private Limited
 



**Location:** 
 Gurugram, Haryana
 



**Position Type:** 
 Full\-time · Remote, based in Delhi NCR
 



**Reports to:** 
 Director of India Operations, with direct work for the CEO (US)
 



**Manages:** 
 People \& Operations Specialist; the operations function as it grows
 



**Hours:** 
 India business hours with a fixed daily overlap into US morning hours (Arizona)
 



**Start:** 
 immediate
 



  





 STEPS Talent is an enterprise technology staffing company operating in the United States and India. We hire for the hardest roles in ERP, Cloud, Data and AI, Cybersecurity, and Engineering. Our India business runs its own client delivery alongside the work we do for clients in the US.
 



  





 We are looking for an operations leader to own HR and business operations for our India company, and the staffing back office behind our client delivery in both markets. You will set the processes, manage one direct report, and be accountable for compliance, payroll, invoicing and the monthly close being right and on time. You will have run this full cycle yourself, month after month, and you will know where it breaks.
 



  





**What you will own:** 




  





**People operations** 



* First point of contact for employees on all HR matters, handled confidentially and documented properly.
* HR policy and process: handbook, leave, probation and confirmation, performance documentation, exits.
* Indian statutory compliance: Provident Fund, Employees' State Insurance, Shops and Establishments, Professional Tax, Gratuity, POSH and the Maternity Benefit Act. You own the compliance calendar and manage the external firm that prepares and files.
* Onboarding and offboarding for employees and interns, the HRMS, attendance and the leave calendar.
* Managing and developing one direct report.



  





**Staffing operations** 



* Onboarding of billing consultants and contractors: agreements, background checks, work authorization documents and client portal registration.
* Consultant timesheets every cycle: collection, entry, tracking and follow\-up before gaps become billing problems.
* Placement records in the system of record, and communication with employer\-of\-record partners and vendors.



  





**Billing and India finance operations** 



* Client invoicing on each client's cycle, including through client portals, and receivables follow\-up.
* Accounts payable with TDS applied correctly.
* India payroll cycle and inputs.
* India books in Zoho Books, bank and card reconciliations, and the monthly close with our Chartered Accountant.
* Monthly intercompany invoicing under our services agreement, and the supporting documentation behind it.



  





**Required experience** 



* 8 to 12 years in HR operations and business operations.
* **Has run a full back office end to end** 
 : HR, compliance, payroll, invoicing, vendors and books, at a company of roughly 30 to 150 people. You will have done these yourself rather than managed people who did them. If each of these sat in a separate department where you have worked, this is likely not the right seat.
* At least 4 years running the back office of a staffing company serving US clients. Corporate HR alone does not qualify for this seat.
* At least 2 years managing a direct report whose work you were accountable for.
* Has personally run monthly payroll and month\-end close for an Indian entity, working directly with a Chartered Accountant.
* Has managed Provident Fund and Employees' State Insurance registrations and the monthly filing cycle.



  





**Required skills** 



* **Indian labor law, hands\-on:** 
 registrations, monthly and annual filings, inspections, notices and assessments, and which obligations are triggered by headcount, wage thresholds and worker classification.
* **TDS:** 
 deduction at the correct section and rate, deposit, quarterly returns and certificates.
* **US staffing back office:** 
 consultant timesheets, W2 and C2C consultants, client invoicing cycles, and client portals such as SAP Ariba or SAP Fieldglass.
* **Zoho, hands\-on.** 
 Zoho Books and Zoho People at a minimum, configured and used day to day rather than viewed. Zoho Recruit is an advantage.
* Written English that is plain and precise.
* Discretion with confidential information, and the confidence to say no when the process says no.
* **Based in Delhi NCR** 
 , or relocating there before you start. We work remotely, and this role includes in\-person work in Gurugram as needed, typically a few days a month, for banking, our Chartered Accountant and statutory matters. You schedule that yourself. Able to work a daily overlap with US morning hours (Arizona).



  





**Good to have** 



* QuickBooks, Tally, employer\-of\-record platforms, or operations across two related companies in different countries working under an intercompany services agreement.
* US HR basics: I\-9, the W\-2 and 1099 distinction, workers' compensation.



  





**What we offer** 



* A defined path to Associate Director at six months, measured against criteria agreed with you on day one, covering both the operations half of the job and the people half.
* Remote working, as the whole of our India team does.
* A direct working relationship with the founder and the India leadership team.
* Compensation matched to your experience.



  





**How to apply** 




 Apply on LinkedIn, or email your resume to Sunny.Patel@stepstalent.com with the subject line "Senior Manager, HR and Business Operations \- \[Your Name]".

 As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. title: Assistant Manager People and Culture
description:
Pasban \- The Gatekeeper is hiring an Assistant Manager, People and Culture for our corporate office in New Delhi.
 



  





  





  





 We operate a portfolio of boutique and experiential hotels — wildlife lodges, nature and wellness retreats, heritage properties — many of them in offbeat destinations away from the metros. The corporate office is small and senior; the People and Culture function is being built now, and this is its first operating role.
 



  





  





  





**The Role** 




  





  





  





 This role is the operating engine of the people function. Strategy is set above; execution sits squarely here. You are responsible for the administrative and operational running of the function — the employee and candidate databases, the monthly payroll cycle, first\-round screening and shortlisting, and the documentation and coordination that keep every property serviced.
 



  





  





  





 Reports to the Head, People and Culture — to the Founder until that position is filled.
 



  





  





  





**What You'll Own** 




  





  





  





 • Database and records management — own the recruitment and employee databases as the single source of truth; maintain the candidate tracker, employee master, personnel files and HRMS, audit\-ready at all times.
 



  





 • Payroll processing — run the monthly payroll cycle end to end: attendance, leave, overtime inputs, joiners, exits, increments, incentives, deductions, payroll register, disbursement coordination, payslips, full\-and\-final settlements, and statutory input schedules (PF, ESI, professional tax, TDS).
 



  





 • Recruitment operations and first\-round screening — post and refresh mandates on job portals, LinkedIn and social channels; source and headhunt where required; screen applications; conduct first\-round telephonic or video interviews; record structured screening notes; present a shortlist; schedule subsequent rounds; complete reference checks.
 



  





 • Onboarding, induction and exit formalities — offer letters, appointment letters, joining documentation, day\-one setup (systems, bank, insurance, identity card, unit introduction), confirmations, transfers, and the full exit process.
 



  





 • Employee lifecycle administration — confirmation, increment, transfer, appreciation and warning letters; leave and attendance system; HR calendar; first point of contact for employee queries on salary, leave, benefits and documentation.
 



  





 • Compliance and audit support — statutory registers and documentation across all locations, renewal tracking, audit\-file assembly.
 



  





 • Engagement execution and reporting — town halls, festivals, birthdays, milestones, offsites, internal communication; monthly people MIS (headcount, open positions, time\-to\-fill, cost per hire, attrition, leave liability, payroll cost).
 



  





  





  





**What We're Looking For** 




  





  





  





 • 3–6 years in HR operations, payroll and recruitment — hands\-on experience running a payroll cycle and screening candidates independently
 



  





 • MBA or PGDM in Human Resources, or equivalent; a graduate with strong HR operations experience will also be considered; hotel management education is an advantage
 



  





 • Hospitality experience preferred; multi\-location or distributed\-workforce exposure is valued
 



  





 • Payroll command — confident with attendance inputs, deductions, settlements and statutory schedules
 



  





 • Strong Excel and systems skills; comfortable on an HRMS and with digital record\-keeping
 



  





 • Screening judgment — able to assess fit on a first call and write a screening note someone else can act on
 



  





 • Documentation discipline — methodical, complete, consistent; nothing filed late or half\-finished
 



  





 • Clear written and spoken English and Hindi
 



  





 • Absolute discretion with salary and personal data
 



  





  





  





**Measures of Success** 




  





  





  





 • Payroll processed and disbursed on the committed date every month, with nil correction entries
 



  





 • No duplicates, no unnamed records, no stale summaries — database verifiable at any time without notice
 



  





 • Applications screened and first rounds completed within agreed timelines; candidates never left waiting
 



  





 • Every employee file and statutory register complete and audit\-ready at all times
 



  





  





  





 Location: Pasban Corporate Office, New Delhi. Scope covers the corporate office and all properties. Occasional travel for onboarding drives, audits and engagement events.
 



  





  





  





 Compensation is commensurate with experience and benchmarked to the role.
 



  





  





  





 Selection process: telephonic screening → in\-person interview at the New Delhi corporate office → reference checks → offer.
 



  





  





  





 Pasban is an equal opportunity employer. We select on capability, judgment and character.

* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation abilities.
* Strong analytical skills for placement data interpretation and reporting.
* Expertise in MS Office (Excel, Advanced Excel, Power BI, PPT).

 **Operational \& Strategic Coordination:** 



* Willingness to travel and manage stretched timelines.
* Handle student counseling, resolve queries, and maintain up\-to\-date knowledge of academic curricula.

**Who Should Apply?** 



* Proven track record in placements, career services, business development, or industry partnerships.

title: HR Associate
description:
**About Arbolus**
 Arbolus is the next\-generation customer diligence platform, redefining how private equity investors and consultants access real, actionable and differentiated customer insight on SaaS and technology companies.
   

  

 At the core of our platform is the world's largest database of attributable B2B customer reviews, giving investment and origination teams direct access to unique customer sentiment and a true strategic advantage to run faster, more confident diligence on the world's leading software assets.
   

  

 Since 2018, we've redefined the traditional expert network model with a tech\-driven approach that delivers high\-impact insight at the speed of modern dealmaking. Arbolus stands out through its unique database of customer reviews accessible via the Arbolus Customer Review Library, Canopy, our market\-first automated Q\&A tool, and our unmatched standard of client service — because great technology should always be backed by great people.
   

  

 Headquartered in London, Arbolus is a venture\-backed scale\-up with 170\+ employees across four global hubs, including Barcelona, New York and Gurgaon. Following a $20M Series B, we are rapidly expanding our U.S. presence as we execute our mission: to digitize human knowledge and make it instantly accessible and actionable.
   

  

**About The Role**
 The People team sits right at the core of Arbolus and is responsible for attracting, supporting and retaining the talent that powers our business worldwide.
   

  

 As an Associate in the People team, you will work across the full employee life cycle — from recruitment and onboarding through to performance management and offboarding — partnering with hiring managers to bring great people into the business and supporting them throughout their time with us. You will also play a hands\-on role in building the culture of our Gurgaon hub, from engagement initiatives to the day\-to\-day moments that make Arbolus a place people want to stay.
   

  

 This is a broad, generalist role with real ownership from day one, and plenty of room to grow as we scale.
   

  

**What You'll Be In Charge Of**
* Managing employee life cycle activities including recruitment, onboarding, offboarding, training, performance management, and compensation and benefits administration
* Partnering with hiring managers to write job descriptions, run interviews and hire the right people for our teams
* Planning and running employee engagement activities — celebrations, team events, wellbeing initiatives and culture\-building moments across the Gurgaon office
* Owning the grievance redressal process, handling employee concerns with care and ensuring timely resolution
* Analysing HR metrics to spot trends and improvement areas across engagement, attrition and performance appraisals
* Collaborating with stakeholders in India and globally to implement People strategies that support business objectives


**About you**
 We're looking for curious and ambitious people who are eager to learn, take ownership and contribute to Arbolus' growth. You enjoy working with people, you're organised enough to keep several things moving at once, and you're comfortable handling sensitive conversations with discretion.
   

  

**Requirements To Succeed In This Role**
* 1–2 years of overall HR experience
* Hands\-on experience with recruitment and broader HR responsibilities
* Exposure to the entire employee life cycle (hire to retire)
* Proficiency using an ATS
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to handle confidential information discreetly


**Nice to have**
* Previous experience in a start\-up or fast\-paced environment
* Experience organising employee engagement or culture initiatives
* Intellectual curiosity and a genuine desire to learn


**What we offer**
* Annual performance\-based bonus on top of your base salary
* 25 days of paid time off per year, plus all local bank holidays
* Comprehensive health insurance and gym membership
* Top\-notch equipment to keep your work efficient and smooth
* Free coffee, tea, snacks and lunch to keep your energy up through the day
* Regular social activities run by our local Social Committees


*We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, pregnancy, age, national origin, disability status, genetic information, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.*
*Arbolus is committed to providing reasonable adjustments for qualified individuals with disabilities, in our job application and/or interview process. If, due to a disability, you need assistance or adjustment in completing your application please email us at* 
*talent@arbolus.com* 
*. Please put "Reasonable Adjustment" in the subject line and provide a brief description of the type of assistance you need. Please note that this inbox is not monitored for application status update requests.*
*We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time. All job applicants must be authorised to work for any employer in the country where the position is indicated to be based.*

title: Senior HR Generalist
description:

Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

 The Human Resources function partners with business leaders to align people strategies with business priorities across Medtronic operations in India and subcontinents.  The Senior HR Generalist serves as a strategic Human Resources partner to business leaders across India and subcontinent region. The role focuses on translating business priorities into people strategies, advising leaders on talent and organisational matters, and supporting business transformation, growth initiatives, and workforce effectiveness. The successful candidate will work closely with leadership teams to enhance organisational performance and leadership capability while fostering a high\-performing and agile workforce.
   

  

**Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:**
* Partner with business leaders to develop and execute people strategies aligned with business objectives and growth priorities.
* Advise leaders on organisational design, workforce planning, succession planning, and talent management initiatives.
* Coach leaders on employee engagement, performance management, change management, and leadership effectiveness.
* Analyse business performance indicators and workforce trends to inform strategic people decisions.
* Collaborate with Human Resources Centres of Excellence, including Talent Acquisition, Total Rewards, and Learning and Development, to deliver integrated talent solutions.
* Support organisational transformation initiatives and guide leaders through periods of change and ambiguity.
* Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders and influence decision\-making through business insight and human resources expertise.
* Ensure consistent application of people practices and policies across multiple countries and business units.


**Required Knowledge and Experience:**
* 5\+ years of HR Business Partnering / Generalist experience, partnering with business leaders in a fast\-paced corporate environment.
* Candidates from premier institutes may be considered with 3\+ years of relevant experience.


**Preferred:**
* Experience partnering directly with senior leaders on organisational design, workforce planning, succession planning, and talent management initiatives.

* Demonstrated experience managing complex employee relations matters, conducting investigations, and ensuring fair and consistent application of HR policies.
* Experience collaborating with Centers of Excellence (COEs) and HR Operations teams to deliver integrated talent, compensation, learning, and organizational solutions.

 ‌
   

  

**Recruitment Fraud Alert**
 We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:
   

  

 Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.
   

  

 Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.

title: Human Resources Executive
description:
**Role Summary** 




**Manage the end\-to\-end HR lifecycle for the blue\-collar workforce — hiring, onboarding, attendance, statutory compliance, engagement and retention — across on\-roll and contractual staff at the site.** 




**Key Responsibilities** 




*Recruitment \& Sourcing* 



* Fulfil bulk hiring for operators, helpers, machine attendants, drivers, loaders, housekeeping and security roles
* Build and manage sourcing channels: local referrals, ITIs, labour contractors, staffing vendors, job melas, field networks and hiring apps such as Apna and WorkIndia
* Screen candidates, run walk\-in drives, coordinate trade tests and roll out offers
* Maintain a ready pipeline so manpower fill rate stays above target at all times



*Onboarding \& Documentation* 



* Verify Aadhaar, PAN, bank details, address proof, medical fitness and police verification where applicable
* Complete joining formalities, ID and access cards, PPE issuance and safety induction
* Maintain accurate employee master data in the HRMS



*Attendance, Payroll \& Vendor Management* 



* Manage biometric attendance systems, shift rosters, overtime and leave records
* Share monthly payroll inputs and resolve wage and deduction queries
* Track contractor invoices, headcount reconciliation and vendor SLA performance



*Statutory Compliance \& IR* 



* Ensure compliance with PF, ESIC, Bonus, Gratuity, Minimum Wages, Contract Labour (Regulation \& Abolition) Act, Factories Act and Shops \& Establishment Act
* Maintain statutory registers and muster rolls; support labour inspections and audits
* Handle disciplinary matters, show\-cause notices, domestic enquiries and grievance redressal
* Liaise with workers' committees and unions to maintain healthy industrial relations



*Engagement \& Retention* 



* Drive attrition control initiatives, exit interviews and stay conversations
* Run welfare activities covering canteen, transport, restrooms, safety drives, festival celebrations and reward programs

*Reporting* 



* Publish daily and weekly dashboards on manpower, absenteeism, attrition and compliance to management

* Graduate in any discipline; MBA/PGDM in HR or MSW preferred
* 2–5 years handling a frontline or blue\-collar workforce in manufacturing, logistics, warehousing, retail or facility management
* Working knowledge of Indian labour laws and statutory filings
* Fluency in Hindi and the local regional language along with working English; strong ground\-level communication
* Proficiency in Excel and HRMS or attendance software
* Willingness to work in shifts and travel to nearby sites



**Preferred** 



* Experience managing large headcount and multiple contractor vendors

* **Manpower fill rate • Time\-to\-hire • Monthly attrition % • Absenteeism % • Statutory compliance score • Payroll input accuracy**

title: Head - People Success
description:
**Head \- People Success** 




**Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Location:** 
 Delhi NCR / Bhopal (Remote today; office\-based once our India office opens)
 



**Experience:** 
 15\+ YOE in human resources, including proven global team building
 



**Reports to:** 
 President, India
 



**Manages:** 
 People Success function across India and the United States
 



  





**About Sutra.AI** 




 Sutra.AI is a complete 'Data to Value' AI business transformation platform designed specifically for Business Builders. Unlike other platforms that cater to AI Builders or large enterprises with substantial budgets, Sutra.AI is purpose\-built for mid\-market businesses without the need of AI expertise. Developed over 4 years, Sutra.AI is a patent\-pending fully orchestrated AI SaaS platform. It identifies and executes AI use cases to enhance operational efficiency, customer experience, revenue growth, profitability, innovation, and risk reduction.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 The Head \- People Success is the single point of accountability for talent acquisition, org design, performance, total rewards, engagement, culture, people operations and statutory compliance across all geographies in which Sutra.AI operates.
 



 The role partners directly with the President (India), the founder and functional heads on structure, hiring sequence and workforce spend. It is expected to challenge those decisions with evidence, not to implement them unquestioned.
 



**Base Location should be Delhi NCR / Bhopal.** 




  





**What You'll Do** 




 1\. Talent Acquisition \& Employer Brand
 


* Build the hiring engine end to end: role scorecards, structured interview loops, calibration standards and interviewer training.
* Own sourcing strategy and channel economics across inbound, referral, outbound, agency and partner channels; know the cost per hire and quality per channel.
* Own how Sutra.AI is perceived by the candidates we most want to attract, including careers presence, candidate experience and offer\-stage conversion.
* Establish a house standard for job descriptions, levelling language and hiring collateral across all functions.
* Close the loop between scorecard and hire quality, and let that evidence reshape how future roles are scoped.



 2\. Global Team Building \& Employment Structure
 


* Design and run hiring, onboarding and people operations across India and the United States.
* Own contractor\-versus\-employee decisions, own\-entity versus EOR calls, and regional employment contract structures; defend each call commercially.
* Build compensation benchmarking that holds across every market we hire in.
* Establish onboarding that produces productive contributors, not oriented ones, within a defined window.



 3\. Org Design \& Workforce Planning
 


* Partner with leadership on structure, spans, layers and hiring sequence, anchored to the operating plan rather than to demand.
* Build and maintain a rolling headcount plan tied to revenue and runway.
* Resolve reporting\-line and title inconsistencies across the existing organisation and establish a single levelling taxonomy.
* Tell leadership when we are hiring the wrong role at the wrong time, and specify what to hire instead.



 4\. Performance, Career Frameworks \& Total Rewards
 


* Design career frameworks and competency ladders per function, defining what good looks like at each level.
* Build a performance cycle from first principles that managers and employees find useful, and that makes promotion decisions defensible.
* Own levelling, banding and the annual compensation cycle across both markets, including internal equity management.
* Own ESOP administration and the employee education that makes equity comprehensible.
* Build a recognition programme that rewards behaviour and outcomes rather than tenure.



 5\. Engagement, Retention \& Wellbeing
 


* Own team health as a measured number: eNPS, pulse surveys, skip\-levels and stay interviews.
* Act on what listening mechanisms surface and close the loop visibly.
* Keep regretted attrition low, and diagnose the true cause behind every exit.
* Make working at Sutra.AI feel connected for people who may never share an office.



 6\. Culture \& Internal Communication
 


* Build the rituals, communication rhythms and feedback loops that make two time zones operate as one company.
* Establish written and verbal communication norms appropriate to a distributed, senior team.
* Keep culture deliberate rather than accidental as headcount grows.



 7\. People Operations \& Compliance
 


* Own HRIS selection and implementation, policy, payroll coordination and the people data layer.
* Own statutory compliance in India (PF, ESI, POSH, gratuity, S\&E, labour codes) and equivalent obligations in the United States and any subsequent geography.
* Build documentation and audit readiness ahead of customer, investor and certification requirements. Our customers operate in healthcare, financial services, aviation and defence\-adjacent sectors and will audit our controls.
* Partner with Engineering and Platform on people\-side controls relevant to ISO 27001, SOC 2 and equivalent frameworks.



 8\. Leadership Coaching
 


* Act as a thought partner to the founders and functional heads on structure, talent and organisational decisions.
* Coach first\-time managers into competent ones.
* Have the hard conversations that nobody else in the company is positioned to have, including with leadership.



  





**Focus Areas (Outcomes)** 



* **Hiring:** 
 Predictable, forecastable hiring with a defensible quality bar.
* **Structure:** 
 A levelled, coherent organisation with clear reporting lines and no duplicated accountability.
* **Rewards:** 
 Compensation that is benchmarked, internally equitable and explainable by managers.
* **Retention:** 
 Measured team health, low regretted attrition and diagnosed causes.
* **Governance:** 
 Clean statutory compliance and audit\-ready people operations in every geography.



  





**What We're Looking For** 




**Must\-Have** 



* **Experience:** 
 15\+ years in human resources, including 5\+ years owning the function as Head of HR, VP People or CHRO.
* **Global Team Building:** 
 Demonstrated hiring and people operations across at least two countries; India and the United States preferred.
* **Compensation Architecture:** 
 Built levelling and compensation frameworks from scratch, not inherited and maintained them.
* **Compliance Depth:** 
 Fluent in Indian statutory and payroll obligations, with practical working knowledge of US employment requirements.
* **Environment:** 
 Direct experience in startups or fast\-growth technology environments; comfortable operating as the entire function before building a team.
* **Talent Market Knowledge:** 
 Has hired engineering, data and GTM talent under pressure and understands those markets specifically.
* **Stakeholder Management:** 
 Proven credibility as a coach and challenger to founders and senior leaders.



  





**Preferred** 



* Experience scaling an organisation from approximately 50 to 300\+ people.
* ESOP design, administration and employee education experience.
* Experience establishing a US entity or EOR arrangement operated from India.
* Exposure to SaaS or AI technology landscapes.
* Experience supporting ISO 27001, SOC 2 or comparable certification from the people\-controls side.



  





**This role is NOT for you if** 



* You need an existing process to run rather than a blank page.
* You view people as downstream of business decisions rather than shaping them.
* You are uncomfortable disagreeing with founders in the room.
* You require permanently remote work. The base location requirement is firm.



  





**Core Competencies** 




 Technical \& Functional Competencies
 


* **Talent Acquisition Systems:** 
 Scorecard design, structured interviewing, calibration, funnel forecasting and channel economics.
* **Organisation Design:** 
 Structure, spans and layers, levelling taxonomy, decision rights and workforce planning against an operating plan.
* **Total Rewards:** 
 Multi\-market benchmarking, banding, internal equity, annual cycle design and equity administration.
* **Performance Systems:** 
 Competency frameworks, review philosophy, promotion governance and manager enablement.
* **People Analytics:** 
 Attrition, engagement and hiring data used diagnostically, not descriptively.
* **Employment Law \& Compliance:** 
 India statutory obligations, US employment requirements, cross\-border employment structures.
* **Distributed Team Leadership:** 
 Culture, ritual and communication design across time zones.



  





**Behavioural Competencies** 



* **Structural Thinking:** 
 Sees duplicated or absent accountability in a messy org and can articulate the fix.
* **Candour:** 
 Disagrees in the room rather than afterwards, with evidence, and commits fully once decided.
* **Data Fluency:** 
 Substantiates claims with cohort, manager and period\-level evidence.
* **Ownership:** 
 Operates without oversight and closes problems rather than reporting them.
* **Written Clarity:** 
 Writes precisely, recognising that in a distributed company unclear writing is unclear thinking at scale.

* Analytical \& customer service oriented

title: L&D Trainer
description:
At Expedia Group, we help travelers explore the world, one journey at a time. As a global travel company powered by passionate people, trusted partnerships, and leading technology, we connect travelers, partners, and advertisers through our consumer brands, B2B network, and travel advertising business.
   

  

 Here, you'll do meaningful work that helps millions of people discover, book, and experience travel with more ease, confidence, and joy. Our five Behaviors\-Traveler First, Think Big, Operate with Excellence, Ownership Mindset, and Succeed Together\-help foster a supportive environment where people can grow their careers and have the flexibility, benefits, and support to do their best work. Join us and build for travelers everywhere.
   

  

**L\&D Trainer**
 The L\&D team is responsible for facilitating learning experiences in a job\-specific area and for on\-the\-job capabilities needed for TPSP’s global footprint. We manage the activities involved in the preparation, delivery and assessment of training and development solutions for Expedia Group TPSP. The team collaborates with Instructional Designers, Operations and Quality Assurance representatives to improve performance. The ideal candidate will be a self\-starter with a passion for talent development, a high level of flexibility, commitment, and the ability to train and coach within a high paced customer centric contact centre environment.
   

  

 Expedia Group brands power global travel for everyone, everywhere. We design cutting\-edge tech to make travel smoother and more memorable, and we create groundbreaking solutions for our partners. Our diverse, vibrant, and welcoming community is essential in driving our success.
   

  

**Introduction to the Team**
 The Product Team creates high\-quality end\-to\-end experiences for travelers, partners, and Expedia Group. Our customer\-first mindset focuses on developing products that encourage loyalty and repeat business from our travelers and partners. We partner closely with teams across Expedia Group to achieve growth and results for our customers and company.
   

  

 TPSP provides the platform and services to handle the service requests from travellers across the multiple brands of Expedia Group, in all locations. This role will partner with the global team, supporting team members, interacting with internal customers (employees) of all levels and external vendors in delivering our products and services.
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Facilitate training to support global TPSP initiatives for different Line of Businesses
* Manage the learning environment: in person and virtual learning and create a positive learning environment in which participants feel safe to try new skills
* Prepare for training delivery by reviewing materials and participant needs
* Facilitate training using various learning methods to meet the needs of learners and the curriculum. Encourage participation and builds learner motivation
* Deliver constructive feedback to encourage self\-discovery and continuous learning
* Ensure learning outcomes by checking for understanding and skill acquisition and report findings and make recommendations to aid decisions making
* Manage projects as assigned by the Learning Team leadership
* Establishes and maintains positive working relationships with agents, peers, management, corporate, and partners
* Report performance of training classes, conduct training needs analysis and plan interventions for performance improvement


**Experience And Qualifications**
* Training: Facilitating adult learning solutions in a contact centre environment preferably within the travel industry
* Communication: Exceptional written and verbal communications skills; ensures the intended message is communicated clearly and in ways that meet the learner’s needs
* Strong organization skills: The ability to develop plans and set priorities; manage multiple priorities at one time
* Problem solving: Analytical problem\-solving skills; linear and logical troubleshooting skills
* Business judgment: Ability to demonstrate good judgment and proactive problem\-solving methods
* Learning theory: Can apply principles of adult learning theory to learning experiences
* Trust Each Other: We are all Expedians. We are accountable to each other to deliver on our commitments, and we will trust our team members to help get it done
* Traveller Focus: Promote a strong disposition to Traveller advocacy. Convey to the trainees how to passionately meet or exceed traveller expectations
* Embodies Expedia Inc. values and beliefs and shares these both internally and externally
* 2 years \+ experience in contact centre
* Travel knowledge: Minimum 1 year experience in the travel industry
* Good knowledge of Data dashboards, LMS, MS\-Excel and PowerPoint
* Willing to work in rotational shifts and weekends as required by the business


**Accommodation requests**
 Expedia Group is committed to providing an inclusive and accessible recruiting experience. If you need an accommodation or adjustment due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please submit a request at https://expedia.service\-now.com/askeg?id\=job\_accommodation.
   

  

**About Expedia Group**
 Expedia Group includes three flagship consumer brands \- Expedia, Hotels.com, and Vrbo \- along with a leading B2B travel business and travel advertising offerings. Across our brands and business, we help travelers explore the world with confidence and ease.

title: Specialist, Oracle HCM
description:
**Make your mark with Thiess** 





 Every day, all around the world, Thiess supports and celebrates our people. We recognise talent, reward transparency, champion diversity and embrace change.
 



 Join us and hone your skills and develop new ones. Take on big challenges and grow through mentorship, collaboration, and empowerment.
 








**The Opportunity** 





 As Oracle HCM Application Specialist within the People Systems team, you will support and enhance Thiess's HR systems and technology landscape, applying strong technical and functional expertise in Oracle HCM Cloud configuration, integrations, and data management to deliver reliable system solutions and process efficiencies that improve the employee and leader experience across the business globally.
 




**Reporting to the Manager, People Systems, you will provide timely, high\-quality technical support to the HR team and broader business, including the scoping, implementation, and optimisation of HR systems projects to ensure accurate, consistent, and efficient outcomes.** 










**As the \[Position Title], you will:** 





**Operational BAU Support** 




 • Act as the first and second point of contact for Oracle HCM issues raised by the global workforce through the ticketing system.
   

 • Be the HR domain expert and HCM functional specialist for the implemented modules including Core HR, Talent, Performance, Goals,
 



**Recruitment, Onboarding and Compensation \& Benefits.** 




  

 • Support strategy and roadmap formulation for Oracle HCM and other HR systems, supporting the Manager, People Systems.
   

 • Triage, investigate, and resolve incidents and service requests within agreed service levels.

 • Make system configuration changes, correct data, and troubleshoot issues across HCM modules.
   

 • Keep clear records of resolutions, configurations, and known issues.
   

 • Escalate complex issues to Oracle Support or implementation partners (CIMIC / Oracle / WIPRO) where needed.
 



**Projects** 




 • Own end\-to\-end delivery of HCM rollout projects, from requirements and solution design through configuration, data migration, cutover, and hypercare support.

 • Define integration requirements between Oracle HCM and other systems, and resolve integration issues.

 • Present project updates, steering committee papers, and post\-implementation reviews to leadership.
 



**Enhancements** 




 • Identify opportunities to improve systems and processes based on user feedback and recurring trends.
   

 • Support the design, testing, and roll\-out of new features, functionality, and quarterly Oracle updates.
   

 • Drive continuous HCM optimisation and automation of operational tasks and reporting.

 Commercial \& Stakeholder Relationships • Look for cost efficiencies where possible, without compromising safety.
